name: Gentle yoga for the back
goal: Slow, gentle poses that move and relax the back, ending with a few minutes of rest. Move only in a comfortable range.
whoFor: People with everyday back stiffness. With ongoing back pain, the lower back pain plan is the main guide.
notFor: Pregnancy: some poses need changes, so a prenatal class is a better guide
A current injury flare-up: use that rehab plan first
Back pain with warning signs (see the lower back pain plan)

items.note: Skip it if arching makes your back worse.
Skip it if bending forward makes your back worse.
